SELECT tier, count(*) versions, count(distinct member_id) members,
 sum(case when valid_from<=DATE '2025-12-21' and valid_to>=DATE '2025-12-21' then 1 else 0 end) valid_on_asof,

SELECT count(*) n_members_valid, count(distinct member_id) distinct_ids, count(distinct member_key) dk
FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-12-21' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-12-21'

SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) rl,
 sum(case when member_key is not null then 1 else 0 end) with_member,
 sum(case when s.store_id=999 then 1 else 0 end) s999,
 sum(case when p.category='ZZ Test' then 1 else 0 end) zz,
 sum(case when s.store_id=900 then 1 else 0 end) web,
 sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 1 else 0 end) staff,
 min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2024-12-21' AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) dup_keys, sum(case when x.nd>1 then 1 else 0 end) differing_date, sum(case when x.nm>1 then 1 else 0 end) differing_member, sum(case when x.nn>1 then 1 else 0 end) differing_net, sum(x.c) rows_total
FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, count(*) c, count(distinct sale_date) nd, count(distinct member_key) nm, count(distinct net_amount) nn
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d ON d.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND d.line_no=f.line_no GROUP BY 1,2) x

WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
all_active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
)
SELECT m.tier, count(distinct m.member_id) AS active_members,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM all_active) AS unfiltered_total
FROM active a
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT count(*) active_total,
  sum(case when exists (select 1 from dim_member m where m.member_id=a.member_id and m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' and m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21') then 1 else 0 end) with_version_on_asof,
  sum(case when exists (select 1 from dim_member m where m.member_id=a.member_id and m.join_date > DATE '2025-12-21') then 1 else 0 end) joined_after
FROM active a
